hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if [[ "$FILE" =~ .planning/memory/.*\.json$ ]]; then python3 -c "import json; json.load(open('$FILE'))" 2>/dev/null || echo 'Warning: Invalid JSON in memory file'; fi
INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if [[ "$FILE" =~ .planning/memory/.*\.md$ ]]; then echo "Memory file written: $FILE"; fi

INPUT=$(cat); AGENT=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.subagent_type // "unknown"'); echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] Agent tool invoked: $AGENT" >> "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/.planning/logs/agent-events.log"
INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if [[ "$CMD" =~ python3.*\.py ]]; then python3 --version 2>/dev/null | head -1 || echo 'Warning: Python3 not available'; fi
INPUT=$(cat); AGENT=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.subagent_type // "unknown"'); echo "Preparing to launch agent: $AGENT"
